entries: How did we end up here!?
Yes, but then you never do, eh?
是啊，可你从来就不会，是吧？
I have seen this place... in passing. When I Blink, I see.
我见过这地方……一闪而过。我闪烁时，看得到。
In all my travels I do not think I have been to a place such as this.
走了这么多地方，我想我没到过像这里一样的所在。
We must make the most of this, as we have so far.
我们必须像此前一样，把眼下的处境利用到极致。
I've been lost before. There is always a way out... I think.
我迷失过。出路总是有的……我想。
Let's be careful. If there are other things as powerful as that creature we will do well to stay hidden.
小心行事。若还有别的存在与那生物一样强大，我们最好藏好。
I do not like the look of this.
